title: SQL Queries: Query Content Items With SQL | Orchard Core
description:
Content items are stored as documents, and their searchable values are written to index tables. Reading a filtered, sorted list of them, or a few columns, means querying those tables.

The SQL Queries feature of the Queries module runs a SELECT statement over those tables. You try it on the Run SQL Query page, pass parameters, use a Liquid condition to shape the statement, and save it as a named query that returns rows or content items.

In this video:
• The ContentItemIndex table and the two kinds of result
• Running a statement on Run SQL Query, and reading the final SQL
• Parameters, defaults and a Liquid condition
• What the SQL parser converts: paging, random order and date functions
• Saving a statement as a query with Return Documents
• Creating a SQL query with a recipe step
• The Manage SQL Queries permission
